T786 (can a row carry its type, scope and capabilities without anyone guessing?) — answered yes: the taxonomy is frozen, not derived. Type: the 9-value vocabulary (audit, infra, orchestration, implement, battery, integration, research, spec, UNKNOWN) is now a registration gate — `managent add`/`suggest` refuse a row without a legal type, erroring with the legal values; `--type` supplies/overrides the bundle's type= key (legacy bundles predating the key may be typed by the flag alone, mirroring --set with that one rescue difference). Scope: the S1–S5 bins from the S07 lattice (task-corpus.md §3) recomputed by a published mechanical rule over the row's own facts (deliverables= ∪ holds= path prefixes + type + id/title words); UNKNOWN is a named residue (R1 no deliverables, R2 mixed facts), never a forced bin. Capabilities: the T900 dimension set (docs/infra/races/capability-metrics.md) adopted as the vocabulary; NOT backfilled onto unraced rows — a capability reading is earned by a graded task, never inferred from brief verbs; the kanban caps field (ROLES.md §4 tokens) is untouched.
